hints.title: Count Available Character Frequencies
hints.text: Record the count of each available letter in an inventory array of size 26.

hints.title: Precompute Word Character Demands and Scores
hints.text: For each word, tally required characters and total score sum across its letters.

hints.title: Explore Subset Combinations with Backtracking
hints.text: Recursively choose whether to include or skip each word, updating available counts and maximizing total score.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded word combinations can grow large, but N <= 14 makes 2^N = 16384 subsets very fast.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Depth recursion with frequency subtraction operates within minimal memory and under 100ms.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should restore letter counts upon backtracking and validate character availability.
